## Contract review
Reviewed at 2026-10-26T17:34Z

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `94fbb7429fd49f952158889416b7e7d1f3dcd3dc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/hooks/session-start-fleet.sh, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md

Reviewer: an independent contract-review subagent, an agent other than the drafter (the in-session os-dev subagent that produced the diff on `claude/project-thread-1r3slx`), whose verdict the owning seat session adopts. Adversarial brief: the inputs were the card, the ruling record, the cap commit, the PR object, file list and diff, the head's check-runs and the trees on `origin/main` and `94fbb742` — not the dispatch order and not the seat's own conclusions.

Inputs: card #26122 body and its three comments (triage first grade 6416685670, claim 6421919798, os-dev-report 6422696560); ruling record 6412560587 on #25768 (author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, the carrier of maintainer Leehom's option 「A 删上限,留读数和立卡门」 with its consequence 「删掉一成上限;保留立卡门和轮次报告的两项读数,产品提交占比连续偏低时由席位报给你」); the cap commit `5f5f0b42` on `origin/main` (stat and per-file hunks); PR #26254 object, file list (3 files, +2/−3) and net diff; the check-runs on `94fbb742`, re-read five times until none was in progress; the cited files on `origin/main` at `1eebbc08` (fetched) and on the head by `git show 94fbb742:PATH`. Merge-base `f2e70836`, one commit on the head above it; the six commits on `main` since touch none of `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `skills/**` or `scripts/pm/**` (measured with `git diff --stat`), so the `origin/main` readings below are what the queue will rebuild against. PR author `user.login` = `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, relay-written; draft; labels `documentation`, `size/xs`, `skip-changeset`; `mergeable: true`.

### ① Derived judgments

Every rule the diff adds, removes or narrows, judged against the ruling verbatim, the triage scope (delete the ≤10% cap, keep the pm-rule filing gate and the two round-report readings, nothing else) and the skill's own regime.

**(a) Exactly the cap, nothing else, nothing less — holds.**
- Removed, `references/execution-duties.md` line 9: 「`tooling` 卡至多占一轮派发的 10%,溢出留积压、⛔ 不入 `pm:queue`;⛔ 无门禁无脚本强制。」 — the D3 cap line `5f5f0b42` added, byte-identical to that commit's added line. Right: this is the rule the ruling retires. The neighbouring candidate rule 「⛔ 排除三门皆无的 `tooling` 卡」 (line 8) is untouched, as it must be — it is the 候选查询排除 reader, not the cap.
- Narrowed, `SKILL.md` line 114 (the `tooling` glossary row): 四具名读者 with 「每轮派发 ≤10%」 → 三具名读者 = 候选查询排除、首触即关、普查半态行. Right: the row on the head is byte-equal to the row `5f5f0b42` replaced (compared against `5f5f0b42^`), so the cap's second spelling is gone and nothing else in the row moved.
- Third spelling: `git grep -E '10%|一成|≤10|≤ 10'` over `.claude/skills` on `94fbb742` hits only `references/platform-readings.md:102` 「GraphQL 端点 2,000 点/分、并发 ≤100」, a rate-limit fact, not the cap; `tooling` with 上限 / 至多 / 每轮派发 over `.claude/**`: zero hits. The cap is spelled nowhere in the skill tree.
- Kept as ruled: `references/filing-gate.md` is byte-identical on `origin/main` and the head (67 lines; line 17 「增改 pm 规则的卡只在维护者点名时立(归 ③,正文引点名原话);⛔ 席位自提不立。」). The two 座位贴协议 lines `5f5f0b42` rewrote for the handover consequence (`seat-lifecycle.md` lines 45 and 47) are untouched. Both round-report readings: see (c).
- The one deletion that is not the cap, `references/seat-lifecycle.md` line 21 「`session-start-fleet.sh` 钩子开会话即印 SKILL.md 触碰 sha 与车道席位贴行,供比对开轮标记。」, is judged **(ii), a legitimate in-file payment under the ratchet** — not (i), not (iii):
  - Not a content loss. The line describes what a SessionStart hook prints; it is not a rule and tells the seat nothing to do. The operative 开轮互斥 rule is intact and self-sufficient without it: line 17 names where the comparison value comes from (after a fetch, the latest touch sha of SKILL.md, the stage references and the lane charter through `git-history.mjs touch`, a proven reading), line 18 what to compare it with (the last opening mark) and what a difference triggers (re-read, then a new mark), line 7 where the opening mark lives (the seat post), lines 19–20 the harness-currency reading (`check-harness-current.mjs`). The hook's printout lands in the session context unprompted, and the hook's own header on `origin/main` ("What it prints", items 2–3) carries the description and points back at 〈开轮互斥〉 itself, so the cross-reference survives in the direction that matters. The deleted line was in fact the weaker of the two readings: the hook prints the touch on the shared checkout's HEAD (labelling a shallow-graft boundary), while line 17 reads it after a fetch through the proven tool. After the deletion the skill tree names the hook nowhere; its only other references are its self-test and `.claude/settings.json`, which wires it. AGENTS.md's principle applies: where a hook does something mechanically, the rule is stated once and the script's header is the authority on detail.
  - Not a scope breach. The sentence it pays for is the ruling's consequence (see (b)), which the ③ card orders added if not carried, 「paid in-file」; the ratchet holds the file at ceiling 96 with headroom 0 and no ruling orders a line delta, so a deletion is the only legal payment. Folding was impossible, re-measured on the head: the product-commit-share line is 118 bytes, the line above it 119, the line below 118, against the 120-byte cap; the sentence is 64 bytes. `5f5f0b42` did not add line 21 (its `seat-lifecycle.md` hunks are lines 42–49 and 68–75), so the deletion reverts nothing of the cap PR beyond the cap.

**(b) The added sentence — faithful.** `seat-lifecycle.md` line 72 「产品提交占比连续多轮偏低 ⇒ 席位报维护者。」 sits directly under the product-commit-share reading (line 71) in 〈轮次报告与节奏〉, in the file's condition ⇒ action form. Against the consequence 「产品提交占比连续偏低时由席位报给你」: same subject (the share), same condition (连续偏低), same actor (席位), same addressee (维护者 = 你). 「多轮」 adds no threshold: the reading is taken per round report (line 68), so 「连续」 can only mean consecutive rounds, and no count is introduced — the maintainer gave none, and a count would be a separate ruling. Not a duplicate: before the PR nothing in `.claude/skills` carried 偏低 or 报维护者 (grep); line 70's 升级项 is a generic slot without this trigger; `SKILL.md` lines 20 and 66 only define the round report as the maintainer's entry point. The channel is fixed by line 68, the chat round report.

**(c) The two readings kept, byte-exact.** From the diff of `5f5f0b42` the two round-report readings are (1) the 48h follow-up-PR count, appended to the 报告加 line 「…与已落 PR 48h 内开出的跟进 PR 数。」, and (2) the product-commit share 「与产品提交占比:已合提交不触 `.claude/` `AGENTS.md` `scripts/pm` 门禁脚本 `.github/workflows` 者。」. Both are context lines of this PR's hunk (head lines 70 and 71, 119 and 118 bytes, unchanged from `origin/main`). No "in-flight tooling share" reading was ever landed: the only 占比 line `5f5f0b42` added to `seat-lifecycle.md` is (2), and the "in flight 12/55 tooling (22%)" figure lives in the ruling record's measured basis, not in the skill. The dev is right: the naming was off, the location right.

**(d) Ratchet and bytes, measured on the head tree.** `SKILL.md` 319 lines (ceiling 319); `execution-duties.md` 187 (ceiling 188, headroom 1); `seat-lifecycle.md` 96 (ceiling 96) — CEILINGS rows 319 / 188 / 96 on `origin/main`, the script byte-identical on the head. Widest `SKILL.md` table row 341 on both revisions (pin 341). The `tooling` row shrank 228 → **206** bytes, not 207 as the PR body, commit message and report say — a one-byte reporting slip, immaterial: table rows are length-exempt, the pin is unchanged and the row only shrank. No non-table line over 120 bytes in `execution-duties.md` or `seat-lifecycle.md`; the five over-120 lines in `SKILL.md` (311, 313, 314, 317, 318) are the pre-existing dispatch template, untouched and identical on `origin/main`. No re-wrap: every freed line is a deleted line, and the two added lines are 206 and 64 bytes. `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`'s headroom rule, read in its header and its code: lowering is "always legitimate and encouraged", never required; the only lowering prompt is an informational nudge printed when headroom exceeds 120 lines. Leaving `execution-duties.md` at 187/188 is therefore no drift to file — the card says ⛔ do not lower unless the ratchet requires it, and the claim names two cards (#26121, #25765) waiting on exactly this freed line. `Lint & Repo Gates`, which carries `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, is green on the head.

**(e) id-lint.** The two added lines carry no issue number (`#` followed by three or more digits, and any run of five or more digits: none); `check:pm-skill-id-lint` rides in `Lint & Repo Gates`, green.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is on the PR and is right: the diff is `.claude/**` only, which publishes nothing from any released package. Body lines 2–3 `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right — no published schema, no authorable key, no export moves. The body carries `## 维护者速读(草稿)` with 改了什么 / 为什么改 / 风险与代价(含回滚) / 你要做的 filled and 席位意见 left empty, as the form requires.

### ③ Boundary flags

PR body acceptance notes and os-dev-report flags, each answered:
- `deviations[0]` branch `claude/project-thread-1r3slx`, not `claude/issue-26122-…`: the claim 6421919798 names this branch as the dispatch's, the PR's `Fixes #26122` ties it, and the checks `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` and `No other open PR may claim the same issue` are green. Accepted; `Implemented-by:` carries it.
- `deviations[1]` base moved: merge-base `f2e70836`, six commits on `main` since, none touching the derivation or governed surfaces (measured above); `mergeable: true`; the queue rebuilds on current `main`. Accepted; nothing for this record.
- `deviations[2]` `check:doc-formula-expressions` exit 3, then green after the prescribed build: a local-run note; the head's `Lint & Repo Gates` is the verdict. Accepted.
- `deviations[3]` the commit carries the model-free trailer pair (`Claude-Session:` and `Co-authored-by: Claude`); no model identifier in the commit message, PR title or body (scanned). Accepted.
- `deviations[4]` hypothesis 2 falsified by measurement: confirmed in (c); the action taken is the ruling's.
- `deviations[5]` fold impossible, paid by line 21, ceiling 188 left in place: confirmed in (a) and (d).
- `open_questions`: none.
- `out_of_scope_findings[0]` and `[1]` (the knock-then-reclaim rule stated under two seats; 「默认每小时」 against `seat-post-protocol.md`'s no-cadence-copy rule): "noted, not filed" is right as far as cards go — `filing-gate.md` 「⛔ 不是卡:…协议观察…它们进座位贴或收班简报」 and `seat-lifecycle.md` 「原则错/缺 → 只进简报,维护者点名才立卡」. The carrier the skill names is the owning seat's 收班简报 (or its seat post), not "none": the seat carries both observations there. Nothing changes on this PR; neither file is in its diff.
- `out_of_scope_findings[2]` `platform-readings.md:102` 「并发 ≤100」: confirmed by my own grep as the sole remaining `≤10` hit and a GraphQL rate-limit fact; right to leave alone.
- Author: `user.login` = `objectstack-fleet[bot]` from the PR object — relay-written, no off-relay login to name. `needs:contract-review` is not on the PR; nothing to remove.
- Tier S landing: on this PASS the owning seat lands the PR through the queue (ready, then arm) with every check green; this record readies, arms and enqueues nothing.

Check-runs on `94fbb742`, final read at 2026-10-26T17:29Z: 44 runs — 26 success, 18 skipped, 0 failure, 0 in progress (the first read at 2026-10-26T17:24Z had the three type-check lanes in progress and the aggregator not yet created; the last lane completed at 2026-10-26T17:28Z). The eight required contexts: `Lint & Repo Gates` success, `TypeScript Type Check` success, `Test Core` success, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success; `Build Core`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI` and `Build & E2E UI` skipped by the paths filter (`filter` success), the standard outcome for a `.claude/**`-only diff. Also green: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, both claim guards and the single-writer-path guard.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` · 2026-10-26T17:36Z

Seat review of record for #26122 on head `94fbb742`, against GitHub, not the report's own account. Governed `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` PR, Tier S: the record that unlocks landing is the independent `## Contract review` at comment 6423017139 (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `94fbb742`, `VERDICT: PASS`, drafted by a reviewer other than the implementer — the in-session os-dev subagent). This seat adds the landing read, not a second contract read.

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, `mergeable: true`; body line 1 `Fixes #26122`, no closing keyword beside any other card number; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; `## 维护者速读(草稿)` present with 席位意见 empty. Files: `SKILL.md` (line 114, the `tooling` glossary row, rewritten in place), `references/execution-duties.md` (line 9 deleted), `references/seat-lifecycle.md` (line 21 deleted, one line added under the product-commit-share reading); +2/−3, all inside the claim's file surface; `filing-gate.md` byte-identical. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 26254`: GOVERNED, Tier S (`.claude/**` ×3, no Tier H path), 5 changed lines. Labels `documentation`, `size/xs`, `skip-changeset` — right, `.claude/**` publishes nothing.
2. **Record, measured.** The reviewer compared both cap spellings against the cap commit `5f5f0b42` (the deleted line byte-identical to the one that commit added; the glossary row byte-equal to the row it replaced), grepped the head's skill tree for a third spelling (only the GraphQL 「并发 ≤100」 fact, not the cap), confirmed the filing gate and both round-report readings (48h follow-up-PR count, product-commit share) survive byte-exact, and judged the seat-lifecycle.md line-21 deletion a legitimate in-file payment: a hook-output description, not a rule, whose authority is the hook's own header, with the 开轮互斥 rule self-sufficient without it; folding was impossible (neighbouring lines 118–119 of 120 bytes). The added sentence 「产品提交占比连续多轮偏低 ⇒ 席位报维护者。」 carries the ruling's consequence with no threshold added. The seat re-read the diff itself and reads the same.
3. **Gates, pinned to head `94fbb742`.** 44 check-runs, 26 success and 18 skipped, none red or pending — among them `Lint & Repo Gates` (ratchet 319/187-of-188/96, id-lint), `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, and all claim/close guards.
4. **维护者速读.** 这张 PR 按裁决记录的选项「A 删上限,留读数和立卡门」把 `tooling` 卡「每轮派发 ≤10%」的上限从技能里删掉(两处拼写都删),立卡门(pm 规则卡只在维护者点名时立)和轮次报告的两项读数(48h 跟进 PR 数、产品提交占比)原样保留,并按裁决后果补一句:产品提交占比连续多轮偏低时席位报维护者。为了在 seat-lifecycle.md 的行数天花板内放下这一句,删了一行只描述 session-start 钩子打印内容的说明(钩子头注本身就是权威)。无脚本、无门禁改动;回滚 = revert 一个提交。
5. **Accepted deviations.** (a) Branch `claude/project-thread-1r3slx` (the measured platform exception), the claim names it and both claim guards are green. (b) Base moved to `f2e70836` before the gate run and `main` advanced since; none of those commits touches a governed or derivation surface; the queue rebuilds on current `main`. (c) The row-width figure 207 in the PR body reads 206 on the head — a reporting slip, the row only shrank, pin unchanged. (d) `execution-duties.md` ceiling left at 188 with headroom 1: the ratchet never requires lowering, and two cards wait on exactly that line.
6. **Carrier, not filed.** The two protocol observations in the os-dev-report (knock-then-reclaim rule stated under two seats; 「默认每小时」 against the no-cadence-copy rule) go to this seat's 收班简报, per `filing-gate.md` 协议观察 — no card.
7. **Landing.** Tier S with a PASS record on the current head and every check green ⇒ the owning seat readies it and arms auto-merge through the relay (`pr_ready`, then `automerge_enable`), on the maintainer's standing word in the seat thread (2026-10-26: 「你按照 pm-dispatch 技能审核的pr都可以落地」), follows it to MERGED, and confirms on both the queue branch and `origin/main`. After this lands, #26121 and #25765 are dispatched in parallel onto the freed line.
